standing_lesson.governing_today: R10 + C16 (and the WHAT I CANNOT SEE block on my card).
standing_lesson.text: R10 governs: the fundamental half (C4, C5, C6, C8, C11) cannot be tested from this file, so I declare it and never infer earnings, ROE, sales, sponsorship or insider ownership from price and volume. C16 governs second and it bites hardest: NOT ONE name in the 162 that also clears leadership, base and stop reaches the volume threshold. The lesson that decides today is the one that cost Thorp his seat integrity on 22 Jul - flow=76.3 on ACGL and lens.insti_money=strong on SHO look exactly like my I letter and are NOT sponsorship counts. They are same-day price/volume proxies, they are advisory only, and not one of them carries a passing step above.

shortfall_reason: Four names, not ten, and every one of them is watch-grade rather than buy-grade. The arithmetic: 162 candidates; 135 carry bracket.valid=false and are rejected outright under C20/R6, leaving 27. Of those 27, rs_leadership=LEADER on 15. Dropping BEARISH_CHOCH structure_shift (no sound base survives a bearish change of character - R3) leaves 10. Removing V (held=true, goes to held_review) and the XLK names SNOW/BILL/MDB (Crown entry_gate=BLOCKED) leaves 6. ELF (rvol 0.84, sma_distance_pct 29.27 vs median 9.31 - extended AND unbought) and SYY (rvol 0.65) fail volume outright. Four remain. THE HONEST HEADLINE: filtering the whole 162 for LEADER + bracket.valid + non-CHOCH + rvol>=1.40 returns an EMPTY SET. Not one name in this universe is a leader breaking out of an intact base on decisive volume. Under C16 as written - below +40% is a hard rejection, not a weaker buy - the strictly correct output today is ZERO nominations. I file four at capped conviction instead of zero because day_vol, the field R4 actually names, is missing from the packet rather than failing in it, and because structure_shift=RANGE on all four says no breakout day has occurred yet - so the volume test is not yet due, which the schema records as no_data, not fail. RYAN is the name to watch: rvol=1.63 is the only real volume among LEADERs with a valid bracket, but structure_shift=BEARISH_CHOCH and lens.structure=warn fail R3 and nothing downstream rescues a broken base. No name here is buyable at conviction 4 or 5; the ceiling is 3 and I am concentrating (C23) rather than padding to ten.
